auth_accounts_email_password_chk.name: auth_accounts_email_password_chk
auth_accounts_email_password_chk.value: ("auth_accounts"."provider" = 'credential' AND "auth_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR ("auth_accounts"."provider" <> 'credential' AND "auth_accounts"."password_hash" IS NULL)

trading_symbols_precision_chk.name: trading_symbols_precision_chk
trading_symbols_precision_chk.value: ("trading_symbols"."price_precision" IS NULL OR "trading_symbols"."price_precision" >= 0) AND ("trading_symbols"."quantity_precision" IS NULL OR "trading_symbols"."quantity_precision" >= 0)

paper_orders_price_chk.name: paper_orders_price_chk
paper_orders_price_chk.value: ("paper_orders"."price" IS NULL OR "paper_orders"."price" > 0) AND ("paper_orders"."stop_price" IS NULL OR "paper_orders"."stop_price" > 0) AND ("paper_orders"."average_fill_price" IS NULL OR "paper_orders"."average_fill_price" > 0)
